items.summaryEn: “Hurun released the 2026 Global Rich List, with wealth as of 15 January” is a Hurun list/net-worth related item. Separate annual snapshots, realtime marks, and funding rumors; this archive only hard-codes closed deals or authoritative list figures. For people born 1990+, cross-check the wealth roster, U30/U40 founder boards, and watchlist for age, self-made tags, and as-of dates.
